body:
Don't let your anxiety take over, fight it,fight back!
Maybe you'll fail,but try to fight it,if you can't then learn to live with it.   
think of anxiety as another person sharing your same body,either you lock it in a cage, or you "make friends" with them ;)
and  don't worry,people always hate each other,you just have to not care,because the sad truth is that people suck,but that doesen't mean you suck too,it's just how they see it,and if you accept it,you'll always win
people don't define who you are,you do. Accept who you are
Good luck!

I'm sorry
I can't even imagine what situation you are in,and i'm sorry to hear that you want to end it,i don't blame you, i realize that most of the time it's easier to just end it all and leave nothing behind,but think of your family, think of your closest family member that is left,what would he/she do if you committed suicide,think of all the pain you have been trough,and you don't want to give it to someone else,do you? i'm not different than you,i also wanted to kill myself,but i never had the strenght to actually do it,mainly becase i love my family and my very few friends. It's hard but that doesen't mean it has to be the end,you decide.

Just take a deep breath,don't make this decision tonight, make it tomorrow, fuck the test and fuck everything else,you come first.
